title: The Green Grass Grew All Around
transcription:
The Green Grass Grew
All Around
A speed-up pattern song

There was a hole,
The prettiest hole,
The prettiest hole
that you ever did see,
The hole was in the ground,

Refrain:
And the green grass grew all around,
all around
And the green grass grew all
around.

Possible lines:
There was a tree
There was a limb
There was a branch
There was a twig
There was a nest
There was a bird
There was a wing
There was a feather
There was a flea
etc.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription; small action symbols omitted and some italic instructions may need verification.
